_metadata.description: Portal Everywhere mandatory acceptance obligations; planned evidence is not completion.

requirements.title: Real capture probe
requirements.description: Given a screenshot executable exists but capture permission is denied, when readiness is inspected, device-control shall ensure: Capture is denied rather than ready.

validation.notes: Implement acceptance case NAT-01 in the device-control producer suite. Required assertion: Capture is denied rather than ready. Retain producer receipt, source fingerprint, and applicable live support row. No passing evidence exists yet.
